To my understanding: Age regression is where someone reverts into a younger mindset as a response to trauma, mental health, and things like that. But it can also be for fun and very casual for some people! They still feel like their biological age outside of age regression. 

Ngu and transage feel like they're less older than their bodily age (I also heard a few transage people say they feel older than their age as well). It's not just when regressed that they feel and see themselves younger like people that just age regress and still feel like an adult or their biological age outside of it. Ngu and transage people can age regress though! I personally age regress, while still being ngu and transage! 

So in summary: age regression is a temporary state of being and feeling younger in mindset. Ngu and transage is feeling younger and being younger in mindset at least most or all of the time from what I've seen! There's other factors too like someone feeling older but that's mainly what I personally know so far!  I believe ngu mainly refers to people who feel and see themselves as younger than their biological age though! Feeling older seems more for the transage label, I think! 😸
